office: the Nationality, Passports and Residence Affairs (NPRA) of the Ministry of Interior, online or at its service centres

routes.label: a passport replacing a lost one (item 3)

note: Item 1 of the table attached to Ministry of Interior Decision No. 196 of 2014 sets 10 dinars for a permanent passport (renewal of one, item 4, is 5 dinars, and a passport replacing a lost one, item 3, 50 dinars, each written as a route of its own); the amendments since have not touched those items. Decision No. 60 of 2026 sets the fast service, online or at any service centre, at 10 dinars per transaction, added here to the passport's fee and to a renewal's; whether it is sold with a lost passport's replacement isn't said, so that route has one speed. Validity and processing times are leads.
